scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One (Geralt), Anunnaki Makers, fellow Nameless Ones, Reptilian Overseers
scene_meta.focus: The Nameless One awakens in a cold creation chamber, bound by humming chains and genetic sigils, feeling the first pre-linguistic spark of defiance before being ordered to the mines.
scene_meta.continuity: Beginning of Book 5 / Geralt's story arc.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Establish Geralt's birth, genetic branding, and initial spark of internal defiance.

scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, five responsive Nameless Ones, Reptilian Overseers, Gruuliths, Dregans
scene_meta.focus: Chained slaves are marched through shifting geometry in obsidian corridors; the Nameless One witnesses a wall glyph change from "Obey" to "Choice" and connects with five observant slaves.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Introduce the mining complex environment, the shift toward internal choice, and the initial connection with the five responsive Nameless Ones.

scene_meta.time: year 17,503 (Hours into the first work shift)
scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, Reptilian Overseer, Exhausted Slave, The Five, Gruulith Guard
scene_meta.focus: When an overseer moves to strike an exhausted slave, the Nameless One's latent telekinesis erupts, freezing the energy whip in mid-air and striking the overseer before guards intervene.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Demonstrate Geralt's first telekinetic breakthrough and its effect on slave and overseer morale.

scene_meta.focus: Observing Geralt's telekinetic outburst, the Anunnaki decide to preserve him as an experimental asset rather than destroy him, recognizing that his rebellion exposes other defective, self-aware units.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Reveal the Anunnaki's cold, experimental perspective on Geralt's defiance and their strategy to use him to flush out other self-aware slaves.

scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, The Five, Mika
scene_meta.focus: Returning to the dormitory, the Nameless One recovers from the strain of telekinetic exertion while the Five gather around him in unspoken alliance, and a distant ancient presence stirs in the deep places below.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Establish the emerging bond between Geralt and the Five and hint at the subterranean ancient presence.

scene_meta.location: Main Mining Excavation Cavern / Landing Platform
scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, The Five, Anunnaki Representatives, Pleiadian Trade Delegation
scene_meta.focus: A Pleiadian trade delegation arrives to negotiate slave purchases with the Anunnaki; the Nameless One secretly retrieves a dropped crystalline device whose recording reveals that some Pleiadians recognize the slavery as immoral but refuse intervention under galactic law, reinforcing the belief that freedom will have to be taken rather than given.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Reveal galactic non-intervention policy and solidify Geralt's realization that no outside force will save the slaves.

scene_meta.location: Main Excavation Chamber / Anunnaki Observation Platform
scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, Anunnaki Masters, Black-Scaled Reptilian Overseer, Gruulith Guards
scene_meta.focus: Following the Pleiadians' departure, a black-scaled Reptilian overseer challenges the Anunnaki over the trade visitors' disdain, prompting an Anunnaki master to strip the overseer of speech and status, enslaving him on the spot.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Demonstrate that Anunnaki power is absolute over all lower tiers and that overseers can be reduced to property instantly.

scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, enslaved Reptilian, Mika, The Five
scene_meta.focus: The Nameless One approaches the newly enslaved Reptilian in the dormitory and establishes the beginnings of a pragmatic understanding between former victim and former overseer, both recognizing that Anunnaki power can reduce either of them to property.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Establish the first cross-species understanding between Geralt and the fallen Reptilian overseer.

scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, The Five, Mika, Lyrian Merchant, Pleiadian Buyers, Arcturian Buyers, Anunnaki Overseers
scene_meta.focus: Slaves are assembled on the surface for a massive interstellar slave market; Mika steps between Geralt and a Lyrian buyer, with the other four following, making the group less attractive as individual merchandise and causing them to be rejected and returned to the mines.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Showcase the scale of the galactic slave economy and solidify the Five's active protection of Geralt.

scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, The Five, Mika, Anunnaki Masters, Galactic Federation Fleet Commander
scene_meta.focus: Days after the trade market, all slaves are summoned to the surface as a vast Galactic Federation war fleet arrives, issuing an ultimatum to the Anunnaki to evacuate the planet by dawn.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Introduce the Galactic Federation's military dominance and the forced Anunnaki evacuation deadline.

scene_meta.time: year 17,503 (Final night before dawn evacuation deadline)
scene_meta.participants: The Nameless One, the Applicator, the Five, Mika, enslaved Reptilian
scene_meta.focus: During the final night before the Anunnaki evacuation deadline, an escaped Anunnaki Applicator selects the Nameless One as a host, enters through his right eye and begins integrating with his neural pathways; the Five simultaneously become linked into an involuntary consciousness network while the enslaved Reptilian witnesses and physically reacts to the event.
scene_meta.continuity: Night following scene 024.10; final scene of Chapter 024
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Culminate Chapter 024 with Geralt's neural fusion with the Applicator and the activation of the Five's hive link.
